title: 《跨境底牌：硅深暗战》全口音与双语飙戏试听包（8 角色 · G1–G8 验收）

acts.title: 全口音与双语飙戏试听总览（G1–G8 声纹/声场/慢拆/同传全门禁验收）
acts.bgm_prompt: Minimalist HBO prestige corporate drama underscore, taut muted solo cello ostinato over sparse dark felt piano chords and subtle low upright bass pulse, cold glass-tower tension, restrained chamber strings, strictly no vocals, no singing, no pop drums, no trap beats, no traditional Chinese instruments, no guzheng, purely instrumental

cues.sfx_prompt: Heavy frameless tempered glass boardroom door swinging shut with a muted brushed-steel hydraulic latch click inside a quiet Sand Hill Road office suite, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: G6/G8: 沙丘路玻璃门开场 Foley

cues.text: [icy polite] That is a charming deck, Lin, truly. [coldly] Now walk me through the eighty million that just flowed through into the income statement before my partners lose patience.
cues.subtitle_translation: 很漂亮的路演文稿，林，真的。现在在我合伙人失去耐心之前，给我解释清楚刚流进利润表的那八千万美元。
cues.director_note: G2/G4/G6: 硅谷美音女合伙人 + -0.15s 负间隔接抢话

cues.text: [interrupting] [measured] That eighty-million-dollar loss is a phantom number—not a cash loss, and your diligence team already knows it.
cues.subtitle_translation: 那八千万美元亏损纯粹是个幽灵数字——不是现金亏损，你们尽调团队早就心知肚明。
cues.director_note: G1/G4/G6: 林沉公开硅谷英文（同一真人双语锚点）

cues.text: [aside] 她把可转债重估包装成经营失血，不是看不懂财报，是想趁签约前把估值砍掉三成。
cues.tts_text: [aside] 她把可转债崇估包装成经营失血，不是看不懂财报，是想趁签约前把估值砍掉三成。
cues.director_note: G1/G6: 林沉贴麦中文 inner_monologue（零混响、验证跨语种音色一致）

cues.text: [understated] [clears throat] Oxford Street shoppers do not subsidize your cloud bill, Mr. Chen. [icy polite] Tell me what is good enough, and what it costs to run this thing a million times without eating into budgets.
cues.subtitle_translation: 牛津街顾客不会替你的云端账单买单，陈先生。告诉我做到什么线算够用，以及把这东西跑一百万次又不啃噬预算要花多少钱。
cues.director_note: G2/G4: 伦敦 RP 男中低音（与 Victoria 美音 3 秒听觉区隔）

cues.text: [blunt] Do not sign that bridge sheet without a hard indemnity cap, Lin. [firmly] Victoria buried a super voting strip on page fourteen, and she is banking on you being too exhausted to notice.
cues.subtitle_translation: 没有硬性赔偿上限别签那份过桥协议，林。维多利亚在第十四页埋了超级投票权条款，就赌你熬得太累没看见。
cues.director_note: G4: Claire Sterling 纽约法务快节奏美音

cues.text: [deadpan] [sighs] 产线刚把微显示模组的 BOM cost 压掉十八美金，硅谷那边又要为公有云 token 账单多烧三十块。[blunt] 听好了，明天切回本地 NPU 推理，不然卖一台亏一台。
cues.director_note: G6/G7: 周默 phone_call 电话带通 + zh-en 双脚本 ASR 验收

cues.text: [measured] At twenty-five percent tariff, your Shenzhen base cost no longer clears our North American hurdle rate. [blunt] Qualify a Vietnam assembly line by Friday, or we reallocate the entire fourth-quarter order.
cues.subtitle_translation: 按百分之二十五关税算，你们深圳基础成本已过不了我们北美门槛。周五前通过越南产线认证，否则我们重分整个四季度订单。
cues.director_note: G3: 印度裔高管国际客串清晰度验收（仅限试听包与 E013）

cues.text: [measured] Ignore the polite modulations coming out of Washington and Brussels, Lin. [guarded] Sovereign capital does not invest in geopolitics—we invest in teams pragmatically adjusting before everyone else.
cues.subtitle_translation: 别管华盛顿和布鲁塞尔的客套风向，林。主权资本不投地缘政治——我们只投比所有人都更快务实调整的团队。
cues.director_note: G3: 新加坡主权基金客串清晰度验收（仅限试听包与 E013/E016）

cues.text: [measured] Under European law, a prompt policy is a polite wish, not an enforcement mechanism. [coldly] Prove strict European data residency on Frankfurt metal, or your glasses never clear customs.
cues.subtitle_translation: 在欧洲法律下，提示词政策只是礼貌愿望，不是强制执行机制。拿出法兰克福本地物理机数据留存证明，否则眼镜永不通关。
cues.director_note: G3/G6: 欧盟法务客串 + vast_hall 听证会声场验收（仅限试听包与 E011）

cues.text: [understated] You pitched tremendous three-year subscription upside in that room, Lin—so answer the only question that matters: when are you going to get it?
cues.subtitle_translation: 你在那间屋里画了巨大的三年订阅上行空间，林——那就回答唯一重要的问题：你到底什么时候拿到这笔钱？
cues.director_note: G6/G8: duck_under_next 同传原声独奏 3.5s -> 0.15 压混验收

cues.text: [aside] 同传叠音测试：在沙丘路谈估值，画再大的远期上行空间都没用，投资人只盯现金到底哪年落袋。
cues.director_note: G6/G8: studio_warm 中文同传叠音轨 + 双行 SRT 验证

cues.sfx_prompt: Crisp minimalist titanium smart-glasses temple haptic tap followed by a subtle ultra-clean low-latency micro-chime and soft optical shutter pulse in close stereo proximity, pure foley, no human voice
cues.director_note: G5/G8: 切入 Act 5 0.80x 慢拆与原速跟读测试

cues.text: [coach] Pick your favorite number—10 times the throughput wins when you run this thing a million times.
cues.subtitle_translation: 参数随便你挑——把这东西跑一百万次时，十倍吞吐量才是硬道理。
cues.director_note: G5: 0.80x atempo 保音高慢拆验收（dry 零混响）

cues.text: [coach] Pick your favorite number—10 times the throughput wins when you run this thing a million times.
cues.subtitle_translation: 参数随便你挑——把这东西跑一百万次时，十倍吞吐量才是硬道理。
